name: Desert Tortoise Recovery Partnership
summary: NFWF partnership with US military and federal land agencies that funds habitat restoration and management for the threatened Mojave desert tortoise in California's western Mojave Desert.

status.quote: Full Proposal Due Date February 16, 2027, 11:59pm Eastern

deadline.quote: Full Proposal Due Date February 16, 2027, 11:59pm Eastern

administered_by.quote: The Desert Tortoise Recovery Partnership (DTRP) was formed through partnerships between the National Fish and Wildlife Foundation (NFWF), U.S. Marines Corps, U.S. Army, Department of Defense, U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service (USFWS) and the U.S. Bureau of Land Management (BLM)

geography.quote: The DTRP seeks to support habitat restoration and management projects that produce measurable outcomes for the threatened Mojave desert tortoise in California's western Mojave Desert.
